name: DescribeOssObjects

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 搜索的关键词，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The risk level ID of the OSS object. Valid values:

1: N/A. No sensitive data is detected.

2: S1. Level 1 sensitive data.

3: S2. Level 2 sensitive data.

4: S3. Level 3 sensitive data.

5: S4. Level 4 sensitive data
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储对象的风险等级ID。取值：
1：N/A：未识别到敏感数据。
2：S1：1级敏感数据。
3：S2：2级敏感数据。
4：S3：3级敏感数据。
5：S4：4级敏感数据
parameters.name: risk_level_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the OSS object matches.

To query the list of authorized OSS objects by the ID of a matched sensitive data detection rule, call the DescribeRules operation to obtain the rule ID
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储对象命中的敏感数据识别规则ID。

如果根据OSS存储对象命中的敏感数据识别规则的ID查询DSC连接授权的OSS的存储对象列表，敏感数据识别规则ID可调用DescribeRules接口获取
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset instance to which the OSS object belongs.

To query the list of authorized OSS objects by the ID of the asset instance, call the DescribeInstances operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
OSS对象所属资产实例ID。

如果根据OSS对象所属资产实例的ID查询DSC连接授权的OSS的存储对象列表，资产实例ID可调用DescribeInstances接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 列表每页显示的数据最大条数
